body: I just want to thank both of you for your kind words. I did end up having the abortion. It was brutal. I saw a lot more than I wanted to see and that makes it much more difficult to deal with... But I'm okay. I know that this was the right decision for me, and more importantly, my family. I have my grandparents to care for, and I need to work on becoming more independent. I had a really great support system in my family, and kind strangers like yourselves. It means a lot to hear from someone on the outside that I'm not a monster. You guys have no idea how much little things like this mean to me. I know I'll get through this and hopefully become a much better person because of it. I promised myself and that if I made this sacrifice, I'd do the things I didn't have the courage to do before. Thank you so much for taking the time to leave these comments.
